About ChatGPT Export Formats

        

          Markdown (.md): Formatted transcript with YAML/metadata header, turn headers, code blocks, and dividers. Ideal for Obsidian, Notion, and human reading.


          JSON Lines (.jsonl): One JSON object per line containing role, content, and turn index. Standard format for LLM prompt evaluation, fine-tuning datasets, and agent context ingestion.


          Plain Text (.txt): Unformatted conversational transcript separated by readable headers. Ideal for quick terminal inspection (grep, cat).
        

      


      
      

        
Zero Data Retention

        

          Exported chats are never saved to a database, logged, or retained. The serverless function serves solely as a stateless proxy, while file parsing and formatting run 100% inside your local browser.
